facts.text: Under the Tuition Freeze policy, full-time undergraduate tuition rates will not increase for students who maintain continuous enrollment.

sources.title: Undergraduate Degree Tuition and Fees | Berkeley College 2026
sources.quote: Full-time tuition rates shall not increase for students who maintain full-time or part-time continuous enrollment in an undergraduate degree program. This policy is subject to change in the future.

facts.text: Honors Program students are required to complete 10 or more hours of community service each term, for 30 hours total over three terms.

sources.title: Honors Program | Berkeley College
sources.quote: Outside of class, Honors students must complete 10 or more hours of community service per term while enrolled in an Honors seminar or 30 total hours across three terms.
